Empty-marker case still returns `Infinity`, so a marker-free draft still reaches `verify-clear` exactly as before — no regression in the clear path.\n- `runVerification`'s `canClear` gains `markerAgeMeasurable &&` before the `>=` comparison, which removes the pre-existing coercion hazard where `null >= minimum` would have evaluated `0 >= minimum`. That matches both prose surfaces (`JIRA_QUEUE.md`, the `--help` literal) and the spec addendum.\n- All three call sites (`unfreezeDraft`, `submitDraft`, `discardDraft`) were converted uniformly; none was left on the old inline ternary.\n- Test coverage maps 1:1 onto the new branches: exit 20 asserted for `submit` (the amended aborted-before-post test), `unfreeze` (the injected-clock test and the new two-case table), and `discard` (new test); exit 2 retained and asserted for unparseable, future-dated, poll-exhausted, and search-failure cases; the exit inventory test pins both `STATE_ERROR === 2` and `INDEX_LAG_BLOCKED === 20` alongside the full sorted set and the retired-10–12 assertion.\n\nOn the three round-17 questions: the audit-reason consumer search is the right shape (it searches destructuring and index-access forms, not just `.reason` property reads) and its single hit is demonstrably an in-memory `gate.reason` within the same invocation, so the persisted-string change is a non-breaking informational-field rename. The `submit` retry-interval path is visibly `EXIT.STATE_ERROR` at line 1221 with an existing test at line 531. The 30s floor is verifiably hard-coded with `Math.max` semantics that can only raise it, and is correctly scoped out as pre-existing.\n\nOne non-blocking maintainability note for a future touch, not a condition of approval: the frozen `VERIFICATION_REASON` object mixes two vocabularies under one field name. `INDEX_LAG` and `SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE` are only ever in-memory gate-result reasons, `MARKER_YOUNGER_THAN_INDEX_LAG_MINIMUM` is only ever a persisted audit reason, and `MARKER_AGE_UNMEASURABLE` is both. Since the gate result and the audit entry both call the field `reason`, a later edit could route a gate-only value into persisted audit data or vice versa without any test catching it. A one-line comment or a split into two objects would remove the ambiguity.
